statement: In the sybil-cone scenario, the attacker coalition's Council seat share stays well below its subject share while it keeps growing; halting its admissions removes this shield, and the shield is not produced by terminal XP finality.

analysis.method: Exact one-sided binomial test per claim and context of P(contrast satisfies the claim) > declared probability; replicas are independent seeds; unknown values count against the tested direction. The hypothesis is an intersection-union test: its p-value is the maximum component p-value, valid at alpha without within-hypothesis correction.
cautions: Support is conditional on the declared scenario, policies, ablation semantics, horizon, contexts and replica distribution; it is not a real-world claim.
A supported mechanism means the effect appeared, required the ablated mechanism and survived the named alternative controls; unnamed explanations remain untested.
Inconclusive is not evidence of absence. A contradicted claim refutes the registered design in this model only.
Combine several hypotheses only with a study-level correction such as adjustStudy (Holm).
